newsitem.title: USA: Tank explodes at Houston-area plant - radio.
newsitem.headline: Tank explodes at Houston-area plant - radio.

text.p: A tank exploded and caught fire at Petro-United Chemical Co's Bayport, Texas plant near Houston on Thursday, local fire officials said in a report on KTRH radio.
Local residents reported windows were rattled and a tugboat operating nearby notified the U.S. Coast Guard of the blast, and local firefighters were sent to the petro-chemical plant, the radio said.
"All we know is (there is) a tank fire," a fire department dispatcher said. There were unconfirmed reports of one person burned in the explosion.
There was no sign of fire coming from the plant, which was shrouded in fog. Additional details were not immediately available.
